purpose: Xenoform Moves library driving clips (motion only; driving person's face never in output)
redistribution_warning: Do NOT commit these mp4s to the public repo; ship manifest + fetch script instead (Pexels/Mixkit forbid standalone redistribution).

excluded.reason: Good wave/white bg but subject described as a young girl (possible minor) - excluded
AIST Dance DB videos are academic-research-only; AIST++ annotations CC-BY-4.0 but derived from restricted videos - avoid for public contest entry

fetch: python scripts/fetch_moves.py  (downloads into library/moves/, which git ignores)
